findings.title: Operation class constructors become a semver-locked public contract
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The classes are value-exported (not export type), so constructors taking the internal Client become public API under a minor changeset that frames the change as type-only.

findings.title: Same class names exported from two subpaths refer to different classes
findings.label: valid
findings.note: encryption/index.ts and dynamodb/index.ts both export four same-named but different classes with different constructors, which leads to confusing type mismatches for consumers.
